title: LNG Sales
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an LNG Sales & Marketing Specialist to join Marketing & Supply Planning Division (MSPD) within Gas Venture Department.
SBDD is responsible for sourcing and developing international gas value chain (upstream, liquefaction, marketing, regasification) investment opportunities. The Division is also responsible for coordinating the execution of these investment opportunities and managing investments post transaction, with an objective of creating a viable, material integrated global gas business by 2035.
Your primary is to work in the incumbent liaisons with the commercial business development team who develop the supply side of the LNG business and lead the contract negotiation and management activities for the LNG sourcing contracts. In addition, you will liaise with the commercial team, the sale & marketing professional and coordinate with Aramco's LNG trading desk to optimize the LNG portfolio.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Identify potential buyers through personal client network, Saudi Aramco client network, or through Market Intelligence reports.
Engage with potential clients to assess potential appetite for LNG purchases.
Assess potential buyer's counterparty risk such as due diligence on operations, financials, management, history, capital structure, credit worthiness, governance and country risk
Negotiate terms of sales contracts, volumes, pricing, timeframe, flexibility clauses, etc.
Liaise with support departments to ensure sales contract is in compliance with local and global regulatory regimes such as taxation, transport regulations, etc. and also liaising with Head of LNG Trading on near-final sales contract to ensure alignment on contract terms and implications on Aramco portfolio.
Sign sales contracts and follow up on administrative execution.
Monitor sales contract's profitability, analyze deltas in profitability and monitor overall portfolio risk, such as open positions per index, credit exposure, etc.
Defining required supply contracts to remain within acceptable range of exposure per index and also defining supply requirements to reach Saudi Aramco's ambitions in maintaining healthy supply- sales balance per index
Identify potential supply sources and reaching out to relevant counterparties.
Assess supply deals, volumes, durations, pricing, flexibility, counterparty risk, chartering and logistics
Conduct re-negotiations of Contract with Current suppliers.
Manage all sales contracts (from Aramco assets & from 3rd parties)
Liaise with Strategy and Business Development to develop full understanding of long-term supply of LNG coming from Saudi Aramco assets, and also Liaise with suppliers to schedule deliveries.
Develop full picture of current and future LNG sales and delivery obligations
Ensure engaged participation of Origination in Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) task force led by Business Development.
Oversee Origination's participation in assessment of the economic viability of investment opportunities in assets driven by Business Development.
Minimum Requirements
As the successful candidate you will have:
Bachelor degree in Business Administration, or Engineering. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will of 15 years' experience with a minimum, including 10 years of experience in SPA LNG sales. You will also have a trackable record of closing sales agreement, preferably in a major petrochemical or energy industry corporation.
You will be able to quickly establish credibility in the position and to effectively interact with all levels of management, including senior leadership.
You will be able to establish and maintain networks, both within and across company organizations is necessary.
You will also have the capability to work effectively within a matrix organization and with multi-disciplinary teams.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Curso técnico em enfermagem.
  • Registro no conselho ativo e em regularidade.
  • Desejável vivência nas rotinas do CME.

Atividades:

  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade no início do plantão, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu atendimento.

  • Assumir as funções inerentes ao Técnico de Enfermagem Diarista na ausência do mesmo, visando dar continuidade e encaminhamento ao expediente do Setor.

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente internado no setor, realizando diversos, tais como: higiene ocular, oral, íntima e corporal, aferição de peso, medir diurese, administrar medicamentos, mudança de decúbito, aspiração de vias aéreas superiores, traqueostomia e tubo oro faríngeo, entre outros, conforme definido nos POPs (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) definidos pela Unidade, visando resolver todas as intercorrências.

  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os Médicos ou Enfermeiros nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: punções venosas profundas, punções arteriais médias, intubações, entre outras, bem como providenciando o descarte dos materiais utilizados.

  • Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela Unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas especificadas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente.

  • Conferir e repor o Carro e Maleta de Parada Cardiorrespiratória, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações.

  • Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seu cuidado, notificando imediatamente aos enfermeiros e registrando na evolução do balanço hídrico qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.

  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição Médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum, preparo de cólon, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.

  • Observar previsões de altas e possíveis transferências, com objetivo de priorizar os cuidados, agilizando o processo.

  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.

  • Preparar corpo do paciente nos casos de óbito, a fim de encaminhá-lo ao Morgue.

  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.

  • Devolver medicações e materiais do cliente em caso de altas, transferências, óbitos ou em caso de modificações de prescrições, todos devidamente identificados com etiqueta do cliente.

  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.

  • Checar e rubricar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, assim como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlar o balanço hídrico rigorosamente.

  • Verificar, os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.

  • Auxiliar os pacientes na ingestão de alimentos, quando necessário.

  • Conferir e testar equipamentos e/ou materiais dos boxes/quartos, sob sua responsabilidade, verificando o perfeito estado de funcionamento e utilização dos mesmos, quando da entrada de novos pacientes.

  • Admitir o paciente junto ao enfermeiro, realizando conferência dos sinais vitais, identificando o cliente com pulseira;

  • Retirar todo material e equipamentos, realizar a higiene dos mesmos e armazená-los em local adequado, em caso de altas, transferências e óbitos;

  • Informar ao enfermeiro plantonista, problemas com equipamentos para que sejam comunicados aos serviços de apoio (engenharia clínica, hotelaria, manutenção predial, supervisão da higiene);

  • Preencher livro de protocolo, no plantão noturno, em caso de empréstimos de equipamento e/ou materiais para outros Setores de Enfermagem."

Role Description Summary
As a NOC Technician, you will work in a 24/7 environment providing technical expertise for Radio Frequency (RF) issues, service performance issues, Occasional Use (OU), full-time managed services and special events. In this position you will offer troubleshooting support and analysis for resolution of service issues. You will be responsible for monitoring, validating and reporting issues affecting our databases and tools. In this role, you will support the integration of new technologies, follow operational procedures, utilize training material and contribute towards departmental projects. You will consistently collaborate to support team/peer leaders and focus on professional development. The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
Primary Responsibilities
Support customer calls and requests in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
Contribute toward and demonstrate a high level of teamwork.
Participate in tool development input to improve customer service delivery.
Assist peer team leaders with service documentation and departmental documentation.
Provide operational support with a timely and professional response to customer calls, emails and any SES-approved communications application.
Participate in routine operational activities, on-boarding of new systems, and alarm monitoring to mitigate customer impact.
Assist with tracking and executing maintenance activities.
Utilize tools and demonstrate general proficiency to troubleshoot RF service issues.
Act as the primary contact for service issue resolution support of RF service issues and a point of escalation for other operations teams.
Assist in identifying, updating, and escalating service issues to determine alternate routing, emergency restoral, and timely resolution of service discrepancies.
Collaborate with SES support groups and/or customer engineers to activate new services.
Create and review tickets for RF interference or service issues to ensure accurate documentation and completion of follow-up actions.
Escalate and report service issues, corrective measures, and next steps to the management team.
COMPETENCIES
Demonstrating core company behavioral competencies, including adaptability, critical thinking, openness, and a positive attitude.
Serving as a culture champion with experience fostering inclusive work environments and embracing diverse thinking and styles.
Contributing to a customer-oriented culture and promoting a quality work environment.
Displaying great verbal and written communication skills.
Assisting in the development of tools, training programs, processes, and procedures.
Performing other duties as assigned by peer leaders and management.
Collaborating with peers and other SES teams to provide a great customer experience.
Familiarization with SES offered products and services.
Qualifications & Experience
Associate's degree or technical school diploma or at least two years of relevant experience in a teleport, network operations, or broadcast environment (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).
Working knowledge of satellite, fiber, data, and/or broadcast related equipment.
General knowledge of video broadcast technology and digital compression desired.
Must be able to work 24x7 rotating shifts.
Must be able to make decisions and collaborate in a high pressure, fast-paced environment.
Must be able to convey complex technical issues to individuals of varying skill levels.
Must consistently display good teamwork, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work comfortably with customers and co-workers who speak English as a second language.
Must consistently display situational awareness and take initiative to address both customer issues as well as departmental inefficiencies with some supervision.
Must have effective computer skills and the ability to read and understand operational manuals.
Other Key Requirements
Job requires ability to sit for long periods of time.
Employee must be able and willing to work in a 24 hour shift environment, with work on nights, weekends and holidays.

title: Regional Partnerships Lead – Community-Led Tourism
description:
At Packed, we are building a decolonial, abolitionist alternative to mass tourism. Our mission is to reconnect travelers with local communities, protect culture from commodification, and ensure tourism uplifts rather than exploits.
We are looking for Regional Managers to join our growing global network. This role is not for those who see tourism as entertainment, but for those who understand its history of extraction in the Global South and want to transform it into a tool of repair and solidarity.
What you'll do:
Map and reach out to hostels, hotels, and guesthouses in your region.
Invite them to apply to become PACKED-certified accommodations.
Explain the benefits: certified partners are recommended to travelers and receive 5% of every experience booked through their unique code.
Build and maintain respectful relationships with local hosts, ensuring their voices remain central.
How it works:
Once an accommodation is certified, your role is complete. Your network might still get in touch with you in case they have specific demands.
From then on, you earn 10% of all experience sales in your region for as long as your contract remains active.
In other words: you work upfront to build partnerships, and in return you secure a passive, long-term income stream.
Qualifications
Required:
Strong communication skills in your local language and in English.
Availability to send and respond to emails at least once a day.
Deep love for your homeland and a genuine desire to protect your community.
Preferred:
Some knowledge of the tourism industry.
A personal history of traveling.
Why join us:
Be part of a decolonial movement that challenges mass tourism and gives power back to local communities.
Shape a new model of travel that resists exploitation and celebrates cultural integrity.
Create partnerships that generate lifelong impact and lifelong income.
This is not a traditional salaried job. It's an opportunity for those who believe in reclaiming tourism and want to grow with us - ethically, sustainably, and collectively.
If this resonates with you, apply through our website and help us make tourism a tool of justice, not exploitation.

Who We Are

At Highstep Technologies, we believe people are the real edge.

Our DNA is built on five core values — Empathy, Excellence, Ownership, Integrity, and Growth Through Community.
These aren't slogans; they guide how we treat each other and how we serve our clients. We call it a values-first culture — where how we work matters just as much as what we deliver.

We show up as one team — employees, contractors, and partners — united by respect, curiosity, and follow-through. We're proud to be the kind of place where people can contribute, learn, and grow together.

Our clients include some of the largest utility and infrastructure organizations in North America — teams who trust us to modernize the systems that keep cities running.

If you find purpose in solving tough problems, bringing order to complexity, and helping organizations change for the better — you'll fit right in.

About the Role

Job Type: Contract
Work Model: Remote
Level: Mid-Level (Non-Senior)

Job Summary

We are seeking a mid-level Functional IBM Maximo Scheduler to support maintenance planning and scheduling operations. This role focuses on functional configuration, operational alignment, and Scheduler usability for planners and maintenance teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Scheduler to support maintenance planning and execution
  • Configure and maintain:
  • Job plans
  • Preventive Maintenance schedules
  • Labor, crew, and shift structures
  • Work with planners and stakeholders to validate scheduling logic
  • Support UAT and operational readiness

Required Qualifications

  • Practical experience using IBM Maximo Scheduler
  • Understanding of maintenance planning and scheduling workflows
  • Experience working with planners or operations teams

Why Join Highstep

  • Be part of transformation projects that make a visible impact for major companies.
  • Collaborate with smart, respectful teammates who value precision and follow-through.
  • Grow in a culture built on learning, inclusion, and trust.
  • Earn competitive pay and have access to real opportunities for career development.
  • Enjoy the freedom to own your work — with the support of a team that has your back.
  • Many of our consultants go on to lead within our PMO, OCM, and MAS practices.

The Invitation

At Highstep, we're building more than a consulting firm — we're building a community of leaders who believe how we work is the real differentiator.

If you see yourself in this description — if you lead with empathy, take pride in your work, and want to make technology feel more human — we'd love to meet you.

Even if your background looks a little different, reach out. The right mindset matters as much as the resume.

Apply now. Let's build the future of Maximo together.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every team member feels respected, supported, and valued — regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We believe dignity and fairness are non-negotiable. We stand against discrimination, harassment, and bias in all forms. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're here to ensure every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed.

title: Customer Data Mgmt Analyst I
description:
About The Job
The person will be responsible for collecting, processing, and supporting the management of information in the exhibitor and visitor database. Analyzing data needs and delivering information. Verifying reporting and dashboard requirements in the BI tool and proposing solutions to deliver more value to the company with the collected data. Involvement in projects related to databases, BI tools, and data privacy.
Activities related to databases
Extract databases and create reports from SQL Server database.
Analyze and propose processes and strategies related to databases for business development.
Evaluate the necessity versus benefits of the data we collect from different sources and bring into our database.
Evaluate the needs and processes always from the perspective of data privacy, using the concept of Privacy by Design and the actual need for each piece of data we use.
Analyze and define the necessary database to meet the event audience plan and visitor profile for the creation of communications for current trade shows.
Periodically monitor the Data Quality Index, suggesting actions, activities, and taking steps to improve the index.
Identify the needs for data processing, acquisition, and enrichment of databases.
Monitor the performance of databases made available to marketing and sales, identifying and proposing solutions for issues and improvements.
Support the Assistant in operational activities related to the exhibitor database and uploading external lists into Salesforce.
Support and execute tasks related to data privacy issues.
Manage the visitor database (VEP) according to the following steps: Perform necessary business configurations; guide teams regarding the data required to reach the target audience; Analyze, approve, support, and reject segmentations.
Evaluate with the responsible areas and make data available for the preparation of post-show report, strategic planning, annual budget and revisions and Lead generation for clients.
Activities related to Business Intelligence
Verify reporting and dashboard needs in the BI tool and propose solutions to deliver more value to the company with the collected data.
Create reports in the BI tool or request from the IT team, according to the demands of the company's projects and processes.
Extract and analyze managerial, quantitative, and qualitative reports to track processes for the involved departments, using BI and ETL tools.
Periodically monitor the available dashboards and reports, requesting or making improvements and correcting errors based on user requests and tickets.
Support in tool management (BI, VEP, Orchestrator)
Monitor the proper functioning of the database and platforms related to visitors daily, and notify the responsible parties in case of issues.
Perform necessary system configurations and check if updates are required.
Monitor the operation of the tools and availability of data and information during events.
Train and guide teams on the use of BI and VEP platforms as users.
Act as an intermediary between the Marketing and IT departments regarding platform issues.
Support and Development of Projects
Support the development and execution of projects related to databases and BI tools.
Support the development and execution of projects related to data privacy.
Report Generation
Generate reports on demand, especially for information not available in the BI tool dashboards.
Create specific segmentations on demand, extracting lists when necessary.
Support in Team Development
Support the Coordinator and Manager in the development of Assistants and Interns, training them on activities, monitoring their performance, and assisting in evaluation and professional development.
Contacts
External relations (suppliers and third parties).
Internal local relations (Marketing, Procurement, Sales, Operations, IT, Finance, HR, and Portfolios).

Experience in analysis, reporting, and presenting results.

Solid knowledge in data and information analysis and management, project management.
Knowledge in database analysis, SQL language, and creating dashboards in Power BI.

title: Supervisor de Logística
description:
VinilSul Contrata

No mercado desde 1995, somos um dos maiores distribuidores de equipamentos e suprimentos para comunicação visual, estamparia digital e refletivos do Brasil.

Com 8 unidades distribuídas estrategicamente além do estoque central, contamos com uma extensa linha de suprimentos, impressoras e outros equipamentos, LEDs para indústrias de luminosos e refletivos para sinalização viária.

Procuramos pessoas motivadas e talentosas para fazerem parte do nosso time

Nosso lema é fazer o melhor e queremos conosco pessoas comprometidas e que amam o que fazem.

Algumas das atividades do nosso(a) Supervisor de Logística:

Responsável por liderar e garantir o bom funcionamento da logística da loja, assegurando o cumprimento dos processos definidos pela Diretoria de Operações. Atua na gestão da equipe (controle de ponto, apoio em contratações, treinamentos, avaliação de desempenho e desenvolvimento), bem como na organização e controle dos estoques, incluindo recebimento, armazenagem, separação, expedição, inventários e ajustes de saldo.

Realiza a gestão da frota, roteirização de entregas e controle de transportadoras, garantindo a correta emissão de notas fiscais, conferência de documentos e administração de devoluções. Planeja, acompanha e otimiza as atividades logísticas por meio de KPIs, reuniões de acompanhamento e integração com outras áreas.

Também é responsável pela gestão de EPIs e uniformes, manutenção do galpão e da unidade em conjunto com a gerência, assegurando boas práticas operacionais, comunicação eficiente entre as equipes e melhoria contínua dos processos.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Superior completo em Logística, Administração, Gestão Empresarial ou afins;
  • Experiência comprovada na área de logística;
  • Vivência com liderança ou supervisão de equipes operacionais;
  • Conhecimento dos processos logísticos (recebimento, armazenagem, separação, expedição e controle de estoque);
  • Experiência com controle de estoque físico e sistêmico;
  • Conhecimento em emissão e conferência de notas fiscais, CTEs e devoluções;

  • Noções de segurança do trabalho e uso de EPIs;

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou cursos de especialização em Logística, Supply Chain, Gestão de Operações ou Gestão de Pessoas;
  • Experiência com gestão de frota própria e controle de transportadoras;
  • Cursos ou treinamentos em liderança, gestão de equipes e feedback;

title: Auxiliar de cozinha hospitalar
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Como parte integrante do Grupo Opalus, o Premier Barra da Tijuca se destaca no cenário da saúde do Rio de Janeiro como referência em reabilitação e cuidados paliativos. Com uma trajetória marcada pela inovação, a unidade é pioneira no estado na implementação do conceito de hospital de transição, mantendo um padrão elevado de qualidade e distinção em seus serviços.

Consolidamo-nos como um hospital de transição estratégico na região da Barra, exercendo um papel essencial no cuidado de pacientes que estão saindo de ambientes hospitalares de alta complexidade. Oferecemos suporte especializado, conforto e segurança no processo de recuperação e readaptação, sempre com foco na humanização, no cuidado integral e na excelência assistencial de nossa equipe multidisciplinar.

Atividades:

  • Executar assistência integral de enfermagem aos pacientes, seguindo as prescrições médicas e de enfermagem;
  • Realizar cuidados básicos de higiene (higiene oral, corporal e troca de fraldas) e conforto;
  • Efetuar mudança de decúbito e mobilização de pacientes conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Administrar medicamentos, dietas e líquidos, realizando o controle hídrico rigoroso;
  • Aplicar oxigenoterapia, nebulização, enteroclisma, enema e terapias de calor/frio;
  • Auxiliar na realização de curativos e procedimentos pós-morte;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das Metas Internacionais de Segurança do Paciente (ex: orientação sobre grades de leito e risco de queda);
  • Registrar em prontuário todos os procedimentos e intercorrências, garantindo a continuidade da assistência no fechamento do plantão;
  • Manter comunicação efetiva com a equipe multidisciplinar e seguir as normas do SCIH.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Técnica em Enfermagem concluída;
  • COREN Ativo e regularizado;
  • Experiência ou domínio técnico em manuseio de: BI (Bomba de Infusão), GTT (Gastrostomia), TQT (Traqueostomia) e SNE (Sonda Nasoenteral);
  • Conhecimento em rotinas hospitalares e normas regulamentadoras da profissão;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala 12x36 - diurno;
  • Perfil humanizado e facilidade em lidar com pacientes de longa permanência e cuidados paliativos.

Benefícios: Vale-transporte,Alimentação no local, TotalPass, Day Off de aniversário, Plano de saúde Amil e odontológico Bradesco, somente após 90 dias da admissão.

Local: Barra da Tijuca

Horário: 8h às 20h

Tipo de vaga: Efetivo CLT

Pagamento: R$2.761,20 por mês

Benefícios:

  • Vale-transporte

Resumo da Função: O Orçamentista Técnico de Obras atua como peça-chave entre o projeto, o orçamento e a execução em campo. Sua missão é garantir a viabilidade técnica e econômica das obras e serviços, por meio de orçamentos bem estruturados, planejamento adequado e suporte técnico às operações.
Trata-se de uma função técnica, prática e estratégica, com atuação integrada entre escritório e obra, sempre sob diretrizes e supervisão da engenharia, conforme boas práticas do setor.
Principais Responsabilidades
1. Orçamentação e Controle de Custos
Elaborar orçamentos preliminares, executivos e paramétricos para obras, reformas, retrofit e manutenção predial;
Compor preços de materiais, mão de obra, equipamentos e serviços;
Apoiar a definição de BDI, margens e estrutura de custos;
Desenvolver cronogramas físico-financeiros e apoiar análises de viabilidade técnica e econômica;
Preparar propostas técnicas e comerciais, incluindo apoio a concorrências e licitações públicas ou privadas.
2. Planejamento e Apoio à Execução
Realizar visitas técnicas para levantamento de dados, medições e definição de soluções construtivas;
Apoiar o planejamento da execução das obras, racionalizando recursos e prazos;
Atuar como elo técnico entre orçamento, obra e gestão operacional;
Acompanhar a execução para validar aderência ao orçamento, escopo e planejamento.
3. Suporte Técnico e Operacional
Apoiar a supervisão de equipes próprias e terceirizadas, garantindo qualidade e produtividade;
Fornecer suporte técnico à coordenação de obras e operações;
Organizar e manter documentação técnica, relatórios, medições e histórico dos projetos;
Apoiar a emissão de contratos, aditivos e relatórios técnicos.

Apoiar o desenvolvimento e leitura de projetos técnicos (arquitetônicos, hidrossanitários, elétricos, estruturais, etc.), sempre sob supervisão da engenharia;
Contribuir para compatibilização de projetos e soluções executivas;
Apoiar processos de legalização de obras e projetos, quando aplicável;
Auxiliar no controle de qualidade, verificando conformidade com normas técnicas e especificações.

Utilizar AutoCAD para leitura, ajustes e apoio técnico;
Utilizar Excel avançado para controle de custos, orçamentos e indicadores;
Utilizar MS Project ou ferramentas similares para planejamento;
Apoiar a utilização de BIM como ferramenta de apoio à orçamentação, planejamento e gestão, quando aplicável.

Obras e serviços de construção civil, reformas e manutenção predial;
Escritório técnico e canteiros de obra;
Interface com clientes, fornecedores e equipes internas.

Obrigatórias:

Excel e Pacote Office em nível Avançado;

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.

As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.

You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.

  • Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.

  • Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.

  • Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.

  • Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.

  • Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.

  • Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.

  • Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels

  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

  • Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)

  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale

  • Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

  • Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

  • Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses

  • Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

  • Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

Buscamos pessoas que se reconhecem como protagonistas, que criam a própria sorte e têm vontade real de construir o novo, do seu jeito, com verdade.

Desde 1978, carregamos no peito a paixão por moda acessível e a crença de que grandes histórias começam quando a gente se permite ir além. Evoluímos, crescemos, erramos, acertamos, mas seguimos inquietos. Porque aqui, inspiração move. E o cliente está sempre no centro de tudo.

Queremos mentes abertas, corações inteiros e atitudes que fazem a diferença.

Gente que transforma rotina em movimento, desafio em oportunidade e time em potência. Aqui, ambidestria é prática: sabemos equilibrar a operação com o sonho, a entrega com a criação, o hoje com o amanhã.

Somos feitos de ambição, mas também de respeito. Com verdade. Com afeto. Se você tem coragem pra fazer acontecer, fome de crescer e brilho nos olhos quando ouve a palavra transformação, esse também pode ser o seu lugar. Se seu sonho é grande, venha ser também.

Quer escrever sua história ao lado da nossa?

Responsável técnico por todas as avaliações de Pré-Formulação que suportam o processo de desenvolvimento de produtos.

•    Conhecer os riscos potenciais presentes nas novas atividades, antes do trabalho iniciar.
•    Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Comercial da empresa.
•    Estar atualizado com a legislação vigente para desenvolvimento de novos produtos e relacionadas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS


ESCOLARIDADE:
- Superior completo em Farmácia, Química, Engenharia Química ou Materiais, Biologia.

CONHECIMENTOS:

- Conhecimentos básicos sobre DSC, TGA, Infravermelho, Raman, difração de raio-X, e analisadores de partículas por difração a laser.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

description:
O Programa Aprendiz Legal é regulamentado pela Lei nº 10.087/2000 e é formalizado entre o jovem e a empresa por meio de um contrato de trabalho que pode durar até 2 anos.
Enquanto a pessoa que é aprendiz exerce suas atividades na empresa, também é oferecido cursos profissionalizantes que complementam sua formação, para que haja um aprendizado teórico e prático mais aprofundado.
A carga horária será de 4 horas diárias trabalhadas, para que não atrapalhe o andamento das atividades escolares.
O participante do projeto também deve estar matriculado e frequentando regularmente a escola, se ainda não for formado.
De modo geral, o propósito do programa é beneficiar empresas e inserir pessoas que nunca trabalharam no mercado de trabalho.

description:
Um aeroporto com a alma carioca
O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.
Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Analista de Inteligência de Mercado Pleno.
Nesse desafio, você será responsável por garantir a organização, integridade e disponibilidade dos dados utilizados pela área de negócios aéreos do RIOgaleão. Atuará como base técnica para o planejamento e o acompanhamento do mercado, assegurando dados confiáveis e padronizados, e apoiando a elaboração de relatórios executivos, análises e decisões estratégicas
Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades:
Estruturar, consolidar e analisar bases de dados relacionadas ao mercado aéreo, conectividade, demanda e performance de rotas, assegurando qualidade e consistência das informações;
Desenvolver e manter rotinas de automação e tratamento de dados, utilizando ferramentas de ciência de dados para ganho de eficiência e padronização das análises;
Contribuir para iniciativas de inovação, automação e melhoria contínua dos processos de dados aplicados ao negócio;
Documentar metodologias, premissas e processos analíticos, assegurando continuidade e evolução do conhecimento da área;
Monitorar indicadores estratégicos, bem como a elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e materiais executivos para suporte à tomada de decisão;
Acompanhar tendências do mercado aéreo, concorrência e dinâmica de hubs, contribuindo com análises comparativas e visão estratégica.
Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:
Formação em Engenharia, Economia, Estatística ou Correlatos;
Experiência/Atuação em Ciência de Dados, Business Intelligence, Planejamento Estratégico, Inteligência de Mercado, Consultoria;
Power BI avançado, com domínio em modelagem de dados, ETL e linguagem DAX para desenvolvimento de business intelligence;
Python intermediário, sendo desejável experiencia em manipulação e tratamento de dados, automação de rotinas, integração com banco de dados, qualidade e governança de dados;
SQL intermediário, com capacidade de estruturar e manipular grandes volumes de dados;
Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Excel e Power Point;
Inglês avançado;
Perfil analítico, com senso crítico, curiosidade e inquietação para aprofundar análises e solucionar demandas;
Capacidade de trabalhar com independência e organização, mantendo postura tranquila mesmo sob pressão;
Proatividade para buscar informações e construir entregas de forma autônoma;
Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes áreas e traduzir dados em insights estratégicos;
Possuir as Atitudes GATE do Integrante RIOgaleão: Garra e Determinação, Autodesenvolvimento, Trabalho em Equipe e Espírito de Dono.
Você sai na frente com:
Pós-Graduação cursando ou completa em Data Science;
Conhecimento do mercado aéreo;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de mercado – exemplo: Airport-IS, OAG e Sabre.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for a proactive Sales Support Specialist to join our team in Rio de Janeiro

Category

Sales Support

Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Deadline

Reference

RCP-

A world-class company


Welltec is a fast-growing, global technology company that develops and provides efficient, hi-tech solutions for the energy industry. We are active in 25 countries with more than 950 employees from over 60 different nations. This contributes to our unique atmosphere with a global dimension yet a strong foothold at the various bases.

Our technologies and services are for the global market but our solutions are local and tailored to each client. To achieve this, we depend on highly trained and motivated employees.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we operate and train employees at the Welltec Academy supplemented with external training from third parties as needed.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employee come from very different backgrounds but with a common goal to collaborate and succeed.

The position


You will be the support person in Sales Brazil. You will be responsible for the daily support commercial staff with all administrative tasks.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the entire team in meeting applicable sales requirements.
  • Be the LAM focal point for CRM, Xaitporter, and good news.
  • Monitor completion (WCS) and intervention (WIS) revenue.
  • Invoice products and services.
  • Receive the PO, monitor manufacturing, and ship equipment to customers.
  • Conduct the local content certification process.
  • Control contracts, their consumption, and related information.
  • Knowledge management.
  • Register and maintain Welltec's account on client/institution platforms.
  • Assist in sales events.
  • Support quality demands (audits, non-conformities).
  • Create reports.
  • Implement process and system improvements.

The candidate


We are looking for a colleague who wants to be part of a small, informal team, who is always ready to help each other. It is also important that you like working in an environment where things are constantly changing. In addition, you must have:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience from a similar position
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Professional in English

And finally, you must be:

  • Service minded
  • Curious and structured
  • Proactive and good at following up

What we offer


Working with Welltec means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting, rewarding and a varied place to work. Welltec is an equal opportunities employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate.

Also, Welltec offers a competitive compensation package, health and dental insurance, Wellhub, Prived Pension and life insurance.

The process


If you are interested and feel you match the qualifications for this position submit your resume and application.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. When you apply, please specify which of our locations that you apply for. You can apply for multiple locations.

Analista consultor do NaPista marketplace automotivo de compra e venda de veículos, com foco em faturamento e qualidade da plataforma, atuante na área comercial em parceria com regional, gerente de filial e GR, com as atividades/ habilidade em: vendas, análise de dispersão; apresentações; operacional.

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Vendas / Relacionamento B2C vender o plano do classificado para os parceiros Keyaccounts (grandes grupos, fornecedores, locadoras), parceiros com perfil digital com mais de 4 classificados, manter e fortalecer relacionamentos com clientes-chave, garantindo a satisfação e fidelização
  • Visitar os parceiros BV com o GR: Falar dos benefícios do classificado, apontar pontos de qualidade na publicação dos anúncios, mostrar a performance da loja em leads e conversão em vendas + financiamento BV, Remarketing entender o perfil de transferência do estoque, influenciar o parceiro a comprar na plataforma de repasse, apresentando os benefícios, facilidade e preço. Devolutiva das visitas
  • Conheça presencial e online : Organizar e conduzir treinamentos para a equipe de vendas, focando no desenvolvimento de habilidades e conhecimento de produtos com grupos de lojistas falando sobre mercado digital, atuar na plataforma NaPista em compra e venda, tempo de resposta e conversão em vendas. Apoiar uma equipe de vendas com estratégias e táticas para melhorar o desempenho, usabilidade, melhorias de plataforma e argumentos de vendas.
  • Análise, compromissos e acompanhamento: Análise da dispersão das filiais, GRs no indicador de faturamento e qualidade, identificar novas oportunidades de mercado e desenvolver planos para evolução do indicador, monitorar e ajustar os planos conforme necessário para garantir a eficácia dos compromissos acordados com a regional, filial e GRs. Preparar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar aos gestores o acompanhamento dos combinados e a evolução de forma semanal decrescente quem evoluiu ou involuiu semana vs semana. Apresentação dos resultados obtidos, o que foi feito, o que deixará de fazer e o que será feito para o próximo mês.
  • Comunicação: interlocução entre áreas, trazendo melhorias e sugestões entre as áreas de produtos, Marketing com a visão da ponta e levar as melhorias para a força comercial, através de apresentação, e-mails e mensagens via WhatsApp. (regionais, GF, GR e Parceiro), visando engajamento e direcionamento para o faturamento e qualidade
  • Agenda Trimestral: Mapa de visitas com antecedência para programação dos meet presencial, aéreo, hotel agendamento com parceiro, GFs e GR.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Nível superior completo áreas administração, marketing, economia, análise de dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas keyaccount, marketplace, ecommerce, planejamento estratégico.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Nível avançado em: Power bi, Excel, powerpoint, outlook, OneNote, canva, copilot.
  • Ter carta de motorista B
  • Disponibilidade de Viagens de 2 a 3 semanas por mês - Alagoas, Sergipe, Ceará, Rio de Janeiro, Paraíba, Rio Grande do Norte e Espírito Santo.
  • Obrigatório possuir carro para as visitas nos parceiros externos

Diferencial

  • Competências e Soft Skills: Proatividade e iniciativa, orientado para resultado, comunicativo, narrativa envolvente, negociação, trabalho em equipe, empatia, inteligência emocional, rapport, organização, flexibilidade e adaptabilidade, persistência, otimismo, análise de dados, planejamento estratégico, gestão de tempo, habilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas e prazos.
  • Condições de Trabalho: horário comercial, disponibilidade de viagens de carro e avião, mobilidade.
  • Treinamentos Necessários: vendas, autodesenvolvimento, inteligência emocional, Excel, powerpoint, Power bi.
  • Metas e Objetivos: Receita, penetração de carteira, venda, qualidade de estoque, redução de churn

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos?

Fundada em 2010, a SPX Capital é uma das maiores gestoras de recursos independentes do Brasil, com cerca de R$ 58 bilhões em ativos sob gestão e 260 profissionais distribuídos nos escritórios de Londres, Nova York, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Cascais e Singapura.

Oferecendo estratégias de Multimercado Macro, Ações, Crédito, Real Estate e Private Equity, a SPX Capital possui gestores experientes, com histórico de resultados de sucesso, combinando capital humano de alta qualidade, processos robustos e valores éticos, construindo assim um negócio dinâmico para o longo prazo.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas, com histórico de excelência;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python;
  • Sólida experiência em APIs REST e arquitetura de microserviços (Backend), desenvolvimento de interfaces web (Frontend), e domínio de Git para versionamento, incluindo branching, pull requests e code review.

Descrição das atividades:

  • Levantar e analisar requisitos técnicos e funcionais junto aos utilizadores;
  • Desenvolver soluções ponta a ponta (Full Stack) para sistemas de execução e controle;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código e a escalabilidade das aplicações.

Local de atuação: Rio de Janeiro

A SPX acredita que a diversidade gera importantes benefícios organizacionais em qualquer equipe e permite que as diferenças sejam transformadas em oportunidades, assegurando condições de pleno desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais e gerando retorno para a sociedade. Encorajamos todas as pessoas a se candidatarem ao nosso processo seletivo.

title: Agente Stone
description:
A Stone:

A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros, focada no(a) cliente e na transformação da indústria de pagamentos para apoiar o empreendedorismo brasileiro.
Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuará em rotina externa para prospectar novos clientes na rota do polo.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes ativos e de pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias do time para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

Conheça um pouco mais a rotina do Agente Stone no nosso manifesto.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável experiência prévia em vendas externas no setor de adquirência ou serviços financeiros.
  • Habilidade em negociação e abordagem comercial
  • Trabalhar de forma orientada a resultados e metas

Nossos Benefícios:

Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Pluxee

 Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.
Team Play: Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
Position is Remote (Canada, or Latin / South America)

No agencies please

Maximus ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine company that empowers individuals to achieve their physical and cognitive peak through precision telehealth care. We are a high-growth, profitable company tailored to ambitious people who refuse to settle for average. We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.

You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that's just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners

  • Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.

  • Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.

  • Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.

  • Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.

  • Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.

  • Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.

Qualifications

  • Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.

  • Demand Gen / Youtube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.

  • Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).

  • Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.

  • Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.

  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.

World-Class Benefits

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility

  • Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.

  • Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people's health and wellness

  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities

  • Full Suite Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance (for US & Canada based candidates only)

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4 year employees)

  • Liquidity of options whenever available

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

Sobre a vaga
Na M. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem
Quem somos
Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.
Nossa atuação e cultura
Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.
Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.
Missão Do Cargo
Desempenhar, sob intensa supervisão, atividades de complexidade restrita relacionadas à manutenções elétricas preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos de produção, bem como os serviços de montagem, teste, ajuste e modificação de circuitos elétricos relacionadas ao processo produtivo.
Responsibilities and assignments
Executar os serviços de manutenção preventiva, conforme padrões técnicos de manutenção (padrões de atividades críticas) e corretiva de máquinas, equipamentos, subestações e Sistemas Elétricos de Consumo (SEC);
Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento produtivo, TPM (manutenção preventiva total), pré-preventiva, entre outros;
Participar do tratamento de falha e quebra, propondo ações de bloqueio para as anomalias detectadas e executá-las;
Efetuar registros no software de gestão da manutenção sobre os atendimentos, com apropriação das horas trabalhadas, tarefas executadas, impactos sobre o processo e materiais utilizados;
Auxiliar a elaborar e treinar equipes de manutenção e operação, através das LPPs (lição ponto a ponto), relatar e tratar incidentes potenciais e riscos de segurança das atividades executadas;
Acompanhar e realizar serviços de montagem, teste, ajuste e possíveis modificações nas máquinas de produção, a fim de garantir pleno funcionamento no processo produtivo e melhorias em conjunto com a engenharia, fabricantes e operação.
Cumprir os requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.

Ensino médio concluído;

No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.

Diagramas elétricos, subestações, normas internas de segurança, boas práticas de manutenção, 5S, pacote Office, leitura e interpretação de desenho, noções de Noções de Noções de Food Defense e Food Fraud.

title: LNG Economist
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an
LNG Economist
to join Strategy & Business Development Division (SBDD) within the Gas Venture Department.

SBDD is responsible for sourcing and developing international gas value chain (upstream, liquefaction, marketing, regasification) investment opportunities. The Division is also responsible for coordinating the execution of these investment opportunities and managing investments post transaction, with an objective of creating a viable, material integrated global gas business by 2035.

Your primary role, as part on the economics modeling team, is to support the commercial business development team who develops the supply side of the LNG business and will lead the economic evaluation of LNG projects in terms of plant investment and offtake trading for investment decision making. Additionally, you will be required to engage with support functions such as Treasury, Group Finance and Strategy & Market Analysis as part of the model sign-off and due diligence process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide analysis of potential joint ventures and mergers and acquisitions primarily in LNG and Upstream opportunities and responsible economic and financial modeling on an unlevered and levered basis
  • Handle complex deal structures, with the development and interpretation of data used in a highly technical and confidential analysis platform.
  • Provide sound investment analysis advice in support of LNG and Upstream Projects for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) deals, by leading economic evaluations and financial due diligence in the deal making process
  • Provide professional and technical expertise for the analysis and solution of complex problems in all areas of financial modeling and economic analysis.
  • Validate and review of seller's models on opportunities related to Upstream and LNG, identify potential problems and recommend solutions.
  • Provide analysis to fully understand and articulate economic value drivers to management.
  • Examine and prepare variance analysis of economic assumptions and high-level technical inputs with functional engagement support.
  • Provide support in preparation of management presentations for progression of deals through the stage gate process.
  • Assist in the formulation and implementation of economic analysis, policies and procedures to prevent or resolve problems and follow-up implemented changes to ensure the problem has been resolved.
  • Ensure that the company standards and processes are reflected in capital projects progression, project evaluations and in analysis of the business and environment through the stage gate process.
  • Train and develop junior professional analysts

Minimum Requirements

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Business. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of related financial modeling work experience, preferably in an investment banking environment or a major petrochemical or energy industry corporation.
  • You will also have experience with Economic Evaluations, Cash Flow & Variance Analysis, structured finance, project finance and/or financial modeling.
  • You will be able to conduct Monte-Carlo stochastic risk analysis and VB excel modelling.
  • You will also be able to quickly establish credibility in the position and to effectively interact with all levels of management, including senior leadership.
  • You will have the capability to work effectively within a matrix organization and with multi-disciplinary teams.

Working Environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Implementations Lead
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As the Rio Implementations Lead, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and local team leadership. You will become an expert in private markets data and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta LPPA software, setting them up for long-term success.

As a technical specialist, you will: Directly interact with clients, managing implementation projects from post-sale requirements gathering to final system setup.

  • Extract the first tranches of data from documents and hand them off to the LPPA MDS team or the clients directly.
  • Train clients remotely over video conferencing and answer technical questions regarding LPPA software and setup via email or quick calls.
  • Establish strong customer relationships as the first post-sale service provider, inspiring long-term loyalty through a smooth onboarding process.
  • Work comfortably with data and business systems to develop training content for customers.
  • Think creatively to find software solutions for both equity and user problems.

As the local lead and future manager, you will be responsible for HR-based initiatives, including:

  • Overseeing onboarding, learning, and development for the local team.
  • Encouraging career growth and performance from both a professional and metrics-driven perspective.
  • Reviewing team and individual performance metrics to provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Leading the execution of strategic initiatives, such as new processes, systems, and tools across the local department.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally to identify customer pain points and provide product improvement recommendations to ensure a "magical" customer experience.

The Team You'll Join


You will be the first service provider post-sale, joining a high-growth environment where you will eventually lead a team of Support Analysts and Specialists. You will work closely with product, engineering, and internal implementations leaders to constantly improve the onboarding experience and service models for new customer types.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex concepts clearly.
  • Organization: Highly organized with extreme attention to detail, capable of balancing multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client-Centric: You care deeply about client services and exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise when communicating with customers under pressure.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Excel and experienced with CRMs (preferably Salesforce).
  • Analytical Mindset: Able to independently identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and execute action plans.
  • Adaptability: Flexible, resilient, and comfortable dealing with uncertainties or ambiguous situations.
  • Leadership Traits: Proactive, ambitious, and a self-starter who takes ownership and empowers teammates to improve.
  • Experience (Plus): Knowledge of finance and accounting, or experience working at a high-growth software company.

title: Accounting & Payroll Specialist (QuickBooks, AP/AR) — Remote
description:
About the Client

PromptPeople is hiring for a fast-growing, high-performance services business supporting enterprise clients in the U.S. The company is scaling quickly and needs a finance operator who can take ownership of the day-to-day accounting workflow, keep the books clean, and bring structure to finance operations.

This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone plug-and-play who can run end-to-end accounting tasks and keep things organized without constant oversight.

Why This Role Exists

The business needs someone to own finance operations end-to-end: AP, AR, invoicing in QuickBooks, payroll processing support, Excel-based reporting, and monthly close tasks. The goal is to reduce bottlenecks, keep finance predictable, and give leadership clean visibility.

What You'll Own (Responsibilities)

AP / AR + day-to-day accounting

  • Own accounts payable and receivable workflows end-to-end

  • Send invoices from QuickBooks, track collections, and follow up on aging AR

  • Process vendor bills, manage payments, and keep AP organized and accurate

  • Maintain clean records and documentation across transactions

Payroll coordination

  • Support payroll processing (including time adjustments, validations, and accuracy checks)

  • Maintain payroll-related documentation and ensure inputs are consistent and clean

Monthly reporting + close support

  • Prepare monthly financial reports for leadership

  • Support monthly close tasks and ensure books are updated and accurate

  • Keep reconciliations organized and up to date (bank and key accounts as needed)

Excel operations

  • Work comfortably in Excel (data cleanup, formatting, transposing datasets, building recurring reports)

  • Turn messy inputs into usable reporting for finance and leadership

Structure + workflow improvement (light systems)

  • Create simple checklists, templates, and repeatable workflows to reduce errors

  • Improve consistency and clarity across finance operations (without needing to "build a full finance org")

What Success Looks Like

First 30–60 days

  • Invoicing, collections, and bill pay are running consistently

  • Payroll adjustments and validations are handled reliably

  • Finance data is organized, up to date, and easy to audit internally

  • Leadership receives clean monthly reporting on time

3–6 months

  • Finance workflows are standardized with checklists and clear routines

  • AR/AP performance improves (fewer misses, cleaner tracking, faster follow-ups)

  • Monthly reporting and close tasks are predictable and low-friction

Requirements

  • Proven experience owning end-to-end accounting operations (AP + AR)

  • Comfortable running finance workflows inside QuickBooks (invoicing, bills, tracking)

  • Payroll processing experience (or strong exposure + ability to own validations/adjustments)

  • Strong Excel skills (including working with messy datasets; transposing / reporting)

  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently without babysitting

  • Excellent English communication (written + verbal)

Nice to Have

  • Experience in service businesses with payroll-heavy operations

  • Exposure to monthly close routines and basic accrual concepts

  • Familiarity with tools like Ramp or AP automation platforms

  • Multi-state / U.S. operations exposure (nice to have, not required)

Benefits

  • 100% remote

  • USD compensation

  • PTO (paid time off)

  • Local holidays

  • Direct work with the leadership team

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • Fast-paced environment with real impact

  • Growth opportunity as the company scales
